---
title: "Web Scraping: Championship Points"
format: html
---

```{r}
# Import packages
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
# Function to retrieve race URLs from seasonal results pages
get_team_points <- function(url) {

  year <- str_extract(url, "\\d{4}")

  read_html(url) %>%
    html_node("table") %>%
    html_table() %>%
    select(Team, Pts.) %>%
    mutate(
      Year = year,
      Pts. = as.numeric(Pts.)
    )
}
```

```{r}
# List of seasonal results pages
season_urls <- paste0(
  "https://www.formula1.com/en/results/",
  1999:2025,
  "/team"
)
```

```{r}
# Run web scraping function on all race results (1989-present)
team_points <- map_dfr(season_urls, get_team_points)
```

```{r}
# write to csv file
write.csv(
  team_points,
  "Data_Files/championship_points.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
